name: Factions of the Chaotic Star Sea

pages.text: The major powers of the Chaotic Star Sea are the Star Palace, the Anti-Star Alliance, and the neutral Merchant Alliance. Consult the in-game codex for their positions, quests, and trade relations. Source index: patchouli_item_book category entry chaotic_sea_factions.
